name: AUMAS
recent: AuMas Resources 近期围绕 Bukit Mantri 矿区的水塘通行权诉讼出现进展，法院撤销了此前的一项禁令。同时，公司 CEO 因涉及 MACC 法案的三项贪污指控而面临法律程序，目前已处于行政休假状态。最新季度财报显示营收同比大幅增长，但净利润环比显著下滑。
notable: 法院撤销了针对 Bukit Mantri 水塘通行权的先前禁令，公司获得关键水塘通行权。
公司 CEO 面临三项涉及 RM18,000 的贪污指控，目前已行政休假。
公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的财报，营收同比大增 97.7%。
risks: CEO 面临三项贪污指控，已进入司法程序。
公司涉及多项重大诉讼（material litigation），包括 Bukit Mantri 水塘通行权纠纷。
季度净利润环比下降 71.2%，净利率从 30.2% 降至 5.1%。

recent_en: AuMas Resources recently saw progress in litigation over pond access at Bukit Mantri, with the court setting aside an earlier injunction. Meanwhile, the CEO faces three corruption charges under the MACC Act and is on administrative leave. The latest quarterly results show strong YoY revenue growth but a sharp QoQ decline in net profit.
notable_en: The court set aside a prior injunction concerning pond access at Bukit Mantri, securing vital pond access for the company.
The CEO faces three corruption charges involving RM18,000 and is currently on administrative leave.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 97.7% YoY.
risks_en: The CEO faces three corruption charges and has entered legal proceedings.
The company is involved in multiple material litigation cases, including the Bukit Mantri pond access dispute.
Quarterly net profit fell 71.2% QoQ, with net margin dropping from 30.2% to 5.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 58,426,000, up 97.7% YoY and 72.4% QoQ; net profit was MYR 2,953,000, down 71.2% QoQ; net margin was 5.1%, lower than 30.2% in the previous quarter.
